summary: Batch B, family B12 (cycle vertex supports): six helpers now unfold to `GTBase.walks_paths.seq_vertices c`, B1's canonical, by conversion. Four have the body `[set v | v \in c]`: Chromatic X153 `x153_cycle_vertices`, Cycle X10 `x10_cycle_vertices`, Cycle X212 `x212_cycle_vertices`, and Digraph X19 `x19_cycle_vertices` over a `diGraphType` carrier. The cross-name Chromatic XE1 `xe1_vertices_of_seq` and Cycle X5 `x5_vertices_of_seq` have `[set v : G | v \in c]`. The family reuses B1's canonical, API and fidelity record (registry path-vertices). It adds no primitive, fidelity owner, API lemma or validity guard: no cycle, uniqueness, adjacency or nonemptiness premise. X19.v imports only the small `GTBase.walks_paths`, as B1's X2 does. Public client base/theories/examples/cycle_vertices.v: empty and one-entry sequences; rotation, reversal and repeats; membership and cardinality under uniq; disjoint supports; the size of a genuine cycle's support; a repeated corner.
Six rows and three intermediates are frozen with this family's helpers only:
- Chromatic X153: the list-critical subgraph of planar girth-5 graphs, with the precoloured-lists chain;
- Cycle X10 and X212: the two Smith rows;
- Cycle X5: #577 (vertex-disjoint four-cycles, with the disjoint-family chain) and #916 (a cycle with an external vertex that has three neighbours on it);
- Digraph X19: Lichiardopol's distinct-length dicycle packing, with the vertex-disjoint dicycles chain, whose disjointness still ranges over distinct list members.

XE1's helper is used by no row, so it has a helper certificate only and no row is invented. Every guard, quantifier order, constant, status and documented note is unchanged. The proof consumers Cycle implications_X212 (the X10/X212 Smith equivalence) and grounding_X212 compile unchanged.

History. `X212Original` is the complete B10+B12 Smith row of X212, by conversion. It uses B10's frozen longest-cycle chain (`Cycle.migration.genuine_cycle.X212Legacy.longest_cycle`, itself over B10's frozen Boolean cycle) and this family's frozen support. Two per-row snapshots are documented reciprocally: B10's X212 Smith copy still calls the live support, and this family's X212 copy still calls B10's live longest-cycle chain. #916 keeps the live `x5_edge_count`. A7 (edge counts, under review at 842ff4d) is not integrated at this baseline, so whichever of A7 and B12 integrates second owes the complete A7+B12 #916 Original (A7's raw rank count with this family's raw support). Both initial snapshots stay. The unrelated A7, B4 and B10 histories of Chromatic XE1 are untouched.
Kernel evidence, independent of this textual report, from `Print All Dependencies`:
- no frozen row or Original reaches a live helper or chain of this family;
- every per-row copy reaches no live constant outside its live row's closure;
- the X212 Original also reaches no live B10 helper, chain or canonical;
- each live row reaches `seq_vertices` and its alias.

Baseline 13c00aa is the announced B11 pin (B10 prose 0a0203e plus B11), not yet integrated; B12 is stacked on it as assigned. No statement text, doc block, manifest row or leg state changes (checked below). The B1 (path_vertices) and B10 (genuine_cycle) specs listed these helpers as untouched distinct variants; they now record that B12 migrated them.
